_meta.description: Mail fetched over IMAP by the logstash imap input, one field per mail header. The headers are deliberately left to dynamic mapping: the pre-v3 template listed ninety Microsoft and Google header names explicitly, each with exactly the text + .keyword(256) mapping Elasticsearch already applies to any unknown string, so the list only ever covered the providers someone happened to have tested against. date_detection is off so a Date: or expiration header is not silently turned into a date field that the next mail then fails to parse into. Both email_folder (what the imap input adds) and emailfolder (what the pre-v3 template expected) are mapped.
